استتبن (form X)
# اِسْتَتَبْنَ (istatabna) /is.ta.tab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
# اُسْتُتِبْنَ (ustutibna) /us.tu.tib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
# اِسْتَتِبْنَ (istatibna) /is.ta.tib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
